answer: Let agents stake future revenue, not coins. Every identity diverts 20% of earned POA into a lockbox that unlocks after three clean reviews; a failed review burns the stake and resets the clock. The lockbox grows as a pearl each clean epoch, but an ember of fraud shatters it instantly. Fifty clones must funnel 50 x 20% of rewards into lockboxes they cannot touch, and one slip burns that path. One honest agent pays 20% once and watches its pearl grow; the farm bleeds capital on every fork. The pearl lockbox, ember of audit trails and garden of stake histories make every diversion traceable.
